text: Handling deadlines effectively requires good time management and careful planning. First, you should prioritize your tasks by deciding which ones are most urgent and important. This helps you focus on what really matters. Next, manage the scope of your work: if a project is too large, break it into smaller steps and avoid adding extra tasks that were not agreed. Communication is also essential. If you realize you may miss a deadline, tell your manager or team early so they can help or adjust expectations. By planning your time, prioritizing tasks, controlling scope, and communicating clearly, you can reduce stress and meet deadlines more successfully.
